newsitem.title: USA: D&P may raise Philippine Long Distance rating.
newsitem.headline: D&P may raise Philippine Long Distance rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Thursday it may raise its double-B rating on the foreign currency obligations of Philippine Long Distance Telephone.

Duff said it placed these obligations on its "ratings watch--up" after it took similiar action to possibly raise the foreign currency obligations of the Republic of the Philippines, which are also rated double-B.
The triple-B local currency rating assigned to the senior unsecured obligations of Philippine Long Distance is not affected and the outlook is stable.

Philippine Long Distance's current ratings reflect a high potential for revenue growth, constructive regulatory treatment, strong historical financial performance and its position as the dominant provider of telephone services in the Philippines, Duff said.
